department: Department of Biostatistics, Mailman School of Public Health

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for admission and funding consideration.
deadline.quote: To ensure full consideration for admission and funding, submit your completed online application by December 1st.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is required.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked.

funding.value: A limited number of fellowships (tuition plus stipend) go to the strongest applicants; international students are eligible.
funding.quote: The Department of Biostatistics offers a limited number of fellowships for students in both the DrPH and PhD doctoral programs. | departmental fellowships are awarded to the most outstanding applicants as funding allows. | International students are also eligible for departmental doctoral fellowships.

entry_route.value: Many entrants hold a master's, but strong bachelor's applicants with a rigorous maths or statistics background are admitted.
entry_route.quote: admission is open to well-qualified students holding (or completing) bachelor's degrees

english_waiver.value: International applicants whose native language is not English, or whose degree is from a country whose official language is not English, must submit TOEFL or IELTS.
english_waiver.quote: All international students whose native language is not English or whose undergraduate degree is from an institution in a country whose official language is not English must submit Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) or IELTS scores.

notes: Awarded by GSAS, run by the Mailman School. The Department of Statistics PhD (stat.columbia.edu) also exists but its pages were blocked when checked.
name: PhD in Biostatistics
